systems.owner: national accreditation, conformity and certification network project (government)

note: Council of Government reviewed progress on a planned national accreditation, conformity and certification network built on testing labs and the GEOLAB platform; it names no standards body, no IT or data standard and no certifier, so it is not a fact (class other).

facts.fact: IANOR's draft 2026 national standardisation programme lists ISO/IEC 14651:2025 (information technology, string comparison and collation) as a revision of existing national standard NA 13037, proposed by CNIG; the document gives the programme's publication date, 2026-02-01, as its only date.

note: Draft programme; the other entries read (library statistics, records management, sampling) are not IT or data standards in the passages seen, and no certification is stated.

facts.fact: Executive decree 98-69 of 21 February 1998 created the Algerian Institute of Standardisation (IANOR), a public industrial and commercial establishment under the industry ministry, charged with drawing up, publishing and disseminating Algerian standards and with adopting conformity marks and authorising their use.

note: Decree names no IT or data standard and no certification against one (conformity marks only, no certifier or standard named), so only the body fact is recorded.

facts.fact: ISO's member page describes IANOR as Algeria's National Standards Body, tasked with developing national standards and managing the mark of conformity to Algerian standards.
